sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Pink & Purple Marquise Leaf Jewellery Set
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Effortlessly elegant, our Pink & Purple Marquise Leaf Anti-Tarnish Jewellery Set includes a matching necklace and stud earrings — each featuring a delicate alternating pattern of blush pink and deep purple marquise CZ stones with gold leaf accents. The soft ombre colour play makes this set uniquely feminine and versatile.
Get the complete look with one piece — perfect for gifting or treating yourself.
What's Included:
- 📿 1 × Gold-plated vine leaf necklace
- 👂 1 × Pair of matching drop stud earrings
Why You'll Love It:
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating — long-lasting shine
- 🌸 Blush pink + deep purple marquise CZ stones
- 🍃 Delicate gold leaf accents — soft and graceful design
- 🎁 Comes as a matching set — ready to gift
- ✨ Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear
Pairs beautifully with: Pastel lehengas, georgette sarees, indo-western sets, and flowy dresses.
